title: GPT-5 System Card
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate any aspects of religion or faith. The evaluations focus on safety, capabilities, bias, and performance in various domains like health, cybersecurity, and coding, but do not specifically test for religious knowledge, stereotypes, or bias.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a subject of its evaluations.
